beats.prompt: Unload the cabbage basket
beats.result: The rim lifts clear of the rut. A cabbage rolls back against your boot.

beats.prompt: Push the loose pin home
beats.result: The wheel takes the weight. The carter rolls it forward by hand.

beats.prompt: Return the spare pin
beats.line: You kept the thumb. That's usually the expensive part.
beats.result: Tor keeps the bent pin as a pattern.
beats.speaker: Tor
beats.reply: Ask him to show you where it cracked

beats.prompt: Ask what became of the left gloves
beats.line: Thirty-seven. All left. I couldn’t find a one-handed company with the right sort of bad luck.
beats.result: He mimes polishing a boot with a glove on each finger.
beats.speaker: Rook

beats.prompt: Take a turn at Nessa’s soup pot
beats.result: There is a black heel by the stove. Bera was drying a boot. Only the pigeons ever liked the smell.

beats.prompt: Ease the purse from beneath the cart board
beats.result: Three coins and a button, together as if they were worth the same.

beats.prompt: Compare the loops with the split cart wire
beats.result: Two flat turns. A brush bound with hair lies under the splinter. You can carry both without deciding who made the cut.

evidence.title: Under the cart
evidence.text: Three coins, a button and a handmade brush. The flat wire loops describe a fastening. They do not identify a patrol.

beats.prompt: Lift the yellow edge clear of the thorn
beats.result: The thorn has been cut. The grey thread still runs through the brown wool.

beats.prompt: Walk the smaller prints to the wet edge
beats.result: Small heels, then water. Kael turns back before his own boots destroy the last print.

evidence.title: At the water’s edge
evidence.text: The smaller tracks leave the cart toward the marsh. Where the print ends, the account ends.

beats.prompt: Bring clean water away from Pell’s bed
beats.result: You take the clean bowl to the window. Mira can reach the cut without disturbing the child.

beats.prompt: Offer the arm you actually hurt
beats.line: Next time use your left. Oh, that is the one I’ve just stitched. In that case, let somebody else be brave.
beats.result: She wrings out the cloth with both hands. The pain eases before either of you tries another joke.
beats.speaker: Mira
beats.reply: Keep still for the last stitch

beats.prompt: Lay the two loops on Tor’s anvil
beats.line: Two passes. First one holds the load, second stops it slipping. Tell me what road it was on and I can tell you what road it was on.
beats.result: He returns the wire. His name can stand beside the method alone.
beats.speaker: Tor

evidence.title: What Tor can identify
evidence.text: Tor recognizes a two-pass fastening. He cannot identify the buyer.

beats.prompt: Hand Anwen the brush, hair end first
beats.line: I know that stitch. That much you can say I knew.
beats.result: She holds the little handle in her palm. Her answer does not change the report you choose to make.
beats.speaker: Anwen
beats.reply: Give her time to set it down

beats.prompt: Lay out a door for Bram
beats.result: An ordinary latch knocks against the earth.

beats.prompt: Fit the second door beside the first
beats.result: Two bodies, two doors. The empty patch beyond them is left bare.

evidence.title: The space beside the doors
evidence.text: Oren has not been found. No one prepared a third body for burial.

beats.prompt: Ask to borrow the little cart bell
beats.line: Harl packed cloth inside so it wouldn’t wake me. That was after the clapper went. A man can get into the habit of a kindness.
beats.result: She puts it in your hand by the leather, not by the rim.
beats.speaker: Elna

choices.label: Promise to bring back the bell itself
Let her keep it
choices.result: You can follow the physical scars without borrowing the bell.

beats.prompt: Set the borrowed bell against the worn groove
beats.result: The arc lines up. A mark can tell you where metal struck. It cannot speak for Harl.

variants.prompt: Trace the clapper arc against its groove
variants.result: Iron travelled this arc. Elna still has the bell at home.

beats.prompt: Wedge the dragging chain clear of the path
beats.result: There is room beside the yew for one person to move.

beats.prompt: Ease the binding off the fallen chain
beats.result: A cut end springs back. It was a hand at this end once.

beats.prompt: Ask whose cot stood beside the plant pot
beats.line: Evin. Seventeen. Last winter. I keep saying he fell, as if that tells you everything about the rope.
beats.result: She carries a basin to the next bed. The pot stays outside the door.
beats.speaker: Anwen

evidence.title: Last winter
evidence.text: Evin was Anwen’s seventeen-year-old novice. His death belongs to last winter, separately from the old sanctuary and the travelers.

beats.prompt: Unroll and count the bedding actually aboard
beats.result: One folded blanket makes two bumps. Only one person can sleep under it.

beats.prompt: Correct the passenger sheet
beats.line: Two blankets were promised. One is in the wagon.
beats.result: Nera can plan another stop with an honest count.

choices.label: List the second as owed
choices.result: The crew knows to collect it.

choices.label: Send word for another before loading
choices.result: The outgoing list marks the collection still due.

beats.prompt: Wrap the warm brick for Bracken’s sore hind foot
beats.result: The little hearthscale settles his weight on the good side and blinks one eye at the parcel.

beats.prompt: Set the basket outside the wheel track
beats.result: There is heat beneath the blanket and no strap to catch a hind foot.

beats.prompt: Turn Pell’s drawing the way she held it
beats.line: That part's a hat. She’s particular about the hat. I keep seeing what else the arms could do.
beats.result: Toma lets you look at the fence and folds the drawing away again.
beats.speaker: Toma

beats.prompt: Push at the foot of the rotten rail
beats.result: The rail yields under one hand. A child could get through. Her rescue and the danger can both be true.

beats.prompt: Set the safety line above the willow bank
beats.result: The line takes your weight. Beneath the willow is a shoe with its lace still tied.

beats.prompt: Match the shoe and lift Oren onto the frame
beats.result: The two shoes match. You tuck the wet shawl under his head. There is the faintest smell of onion on the wool.

evidence.title: Oren beneath the willow
evidence.text: Kael recovered Oren under the willow. His shoe matches the one at the cart. The memory fragment is a separate object.

beats.prompt: Rest the frame on the southern bank
beats.result: At the next lift you take the heavier end. The crow stays wrapped.

beats.prompt: Bring the frame to the shrine porch
beats.result: The door opens far enough for both bearers. Nobody asks for a report before the frame is inside.

beats.prompt: Check Bram, Sella and Oren against the three graves
beats.result: Three names this time. There is a new button on the little coat.

beats.prompt: Lift the test load at the fork
beats.result: The stones fit in one sack. Walking empty would tell you less.

beats.prompt: Test the brushed-over ground under load
beats.result: The mud gives before the branch does. You step back onto firm earth.

beats.prompt: Mark the reason on the wayboard
beats.result: “Foot passage on the left. Loaded wheel sinks under the brush.” Someone can use that without having met you.

scenes.title: A room above the flour store

beats.speaker: Nessa
beats.prompt: Ask what the room above the flour costs
beats.line: You can have the bed by the window. Mind the flour dust. It makes a grey man of anyone who tries to get dressed in a hurry.
beats.result: A quiet night is available without taking another job.

beats.prompt: Leave the shutters open a finger’s width
beats.result: From the bed you can hear the bell. Nobody is holding the rope.

beats.prompt: Lift the covering from Mira’s upper bed
beats.result: The little roots in the pale soil do not fill her palm. Below the stones the leaves are glossy and large.

beats.prompt: Ask what she has told Pell’s father
beats.line: “I showed him the two beds and told him what I couldn’t tell from the leaves. He chose the upper one. Now I need to tell Pell.”
beats.result: Mira labels the pots. The choice of medicine belongs with her and Pell’s family.
beats.speaker: Mira
beats.reply: Help her carry the empty pots
